subject: English
title: Letter y
prompt: Copy the letter carefully, then try it three times without any help.
teacher_note: Phase 3 grapheme. y is one of the 'Down-and-under letters'. Start at the top, curve down and dive below the line. Say the sound as you form it.
curriculum_ref: EYFS ELG: Fine Motor Skills — hold a pencil effectively; begin to form letters correctly
